verdict.rationale: Google ADK is a framework for building agents. Developers could use its model, tools and workflow primitives to construct an agent that analyzes data, but that is a developer building block, not a built-in feature. Nothing in the evidence shows the product itself, such as its dev UI, offering AI-generated insights or suggestions from a user's data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
